_about: One shows on the loading screen. Short, true and in the game's voice.
tips: Golfers pay what a hole was worth to them. There is no price slider. You are building the price slider.
A bunker where the drives land is worth more than a bunker anywhere else.
Unhappy golfers let the weeds in, and weeds make golfers unhappy. A greenkeeper breaks the loop.
A drink stand by the first tee pays for itself in a month and improves everyone's mood on the way past.
Members buy homes with a view. Trees are a view. So is water, from a safe distance.
Early hooks, late slices. Flush is the thin green band on the line.
Backspin bites on a green and can pull the ball back. It does nothing out of the rough.
The wind is stronger up high. A punch stays under it.
Floodlights turn night into paying golf. Light the hole from tee to green or it does not count.
The magazine critic plays twice. The second round decides the review.
Two strangers in the same group keep booking the same tee time. A bench by the water helps.
Hold Option and drag to turn the view. Alt on Windows and Linux. Or use the Camera bar.
Click a golfer, then F, to follow them round. Their thoughts float above their heads.
The starter clubhouse allows three holes. Members and a rating earn the next step up.
Uphill lies fly higher and shorter. Downhill lies run. The panel tells you before you swing.
Host a tournament and a gallery turns out. They groan at the water hazards. So will you.
The land for sale is darker. Each parcel costs a little more than the last.
Spring leaves come in pale. In September the trees turn. Your course is a year long.
